body.purpose: UI chrome, lists, form copy at 14px.

greeting.purpose: Georgia serif welcome and view titles.

shadows.name: floating
shadows.purpose: Dialogs, popovers, palette and toasts only.

motion.name: duration-fast
motion.purpose: Hover, focus and grid column transitions.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single main action on a screen (Send is a round variant).
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 6px; height: 32px; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid #c96442; border-radius: 4px; background: #c96442; color: #fff; font: 500 13px ui-sans-serif, system-ui, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { filter: brightness(1.1); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #c96442; outline-offset: 1px; }

components.name: Default Button
components.description: Supporting actions on a surface with a hairline border.
components.css: .ds-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 6px; height: 32px; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid #3d3d3d; border-radius: 4px; background: #2b2b2b; color: #f2f2f2; font: 500 13px ui-sans-serif, system-ui, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,.06); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #c96442; outline-offset: 1px; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Single-line fields with an accent focus ring.
components.css: .ds-input { height: 32px; width: 100%; padding: 0 10px; border: 1px solid #3d3d3d; border-radius: 8px; background: #323232; color: #f2f2f2; font: 400 14px ui-sans-serif, system-ui, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #a0a0a0; } .ds-input:focus { outline: none; border-color: #c96442; box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px #c96442; }

components.name: Message Bubble
components.description: A user message, right aligned, on the raised surface.
components.html: Short answer: yes, start with the simplest version.
components.css: .ds-msg { max-width: 80%; padding: 10px 14px; border: 1px solid #3d3d3d; border-radius: 12px; background: #323232; color: #f2f2f2; font: 400 15px/1.6 ui-sans-serif, system-ui, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; white-space: pre-wrap; }

components.name: Sidebar Row
components.description: A conversation row; the active one carries a 3px accent bar.
components.css: .ds-row { position: relative; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; height: 34px; padding: 0 10px; border-radius: 4px; color: #f2f2f2; font: 400 14px ui-sans-serif, system-ui, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-row:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,.06); } .ds-row-active { background: rgba(255,255,255,.1); } .ds-row-active::before { content: ""; position: absolute; left: 0; top: 8px; bottom: 8px; width: 3px; border-radius: 2px; background: #c96442; } .ds-row-label { overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; }

components.name: Artifact Panel
components.description: Signature 420px right-hand pane with Preview/Code or Doc/Source tabs.
components.css: .ds-artifact { display: flex; flex-direction: column; width: 420px; border-left: 1px solid #3d3d3d; background: #2b2b2b; } .ds-artifact-head { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; height: 48px; padding: 0 8px 0 14px; border-bottom: 1px solid #3d3d3d; font: 500 14px ui-sans-serif, system-ui, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-artifact-code { margin: 0; padding: 14px; overflow: auto; font: 400 13px/1.5 Consolas, monospace; white-space: pre-wrap; }

narrative.overview: A Windows desktop room the user controls: a 32px title bar with real caption buttons, a quiet sidebar, a centered reading column, and an artifact pane beside the chat. Surfaces are flat charcoal steps separated by hairline borders; a single terracotta accent marks the few things that act. The system ships in light and dark themes sharing one structure; dark is the reference. Type is the system UI stack except the Georgia serif greeting and Cascadia Code.
keyCharacteristics: Windows-native shell: custom title bar, 900px minimum width, Ctrl-first shortcuts.
Flat tonal ladder, hairline borders, one terracotta accent.
Serif greeting, system UI body, monospace code.

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: Color appears only to carry meaning. If a color would merely decorate, it is not used.

rules.name: The Accent-Is-Action Rule
rules.body: The accent marks things the user can act on — never plain text, never selection alone.

rules.name: The Serif-Is-Greeting Rule
rules.body: Serif appears only in the welcome greeting and top-level view titles.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: No shadows on surfaces; floating layers alone may cast one.

dos: Do separate regions with a 1px Line border or a step on the tonal ladder.
Do reserve the primary button for the single main action on a screen.
Do keep the reading column at 760px and the welcome column at 720px.
Do show keyboard focus with a visible 2px accent ring on every control.
Do keep destructive actions behind the confirm dialog.
donts: Don't add shadows to surfaces; floating layers only.
Don't load a webfont or use serif outside greetings and view titles.
Don't ship a control that does nothing.
Don't use color as the only cue for state.
